config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(rise) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('pod.merged_lines') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND $__filters)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR

SELECT sum(rise) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now())) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT sum(rise) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR

SELECT if(sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests') = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests' AND Attributes['outcome'] = 'typed') / sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests')) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now())) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT if(sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests') = 0, NULL, sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests' AND Attributes['outcome'] = 'typed') / sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests')) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR

SELECT if(sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests') = 0, NULL, (sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests' AND Attributes['outcome'] = 'typed') - sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests.wrong')) / sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests')) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests', 'harold.phone_requests.wrong') AND (MetricName != 'harold.phone_requests' OR Attributes['channel'] != 'web_app') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now())) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT if(sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests') = 0, NULL, (sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests' AND Attributes['outcome'] = 'typed') - sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests.wrong')) / sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.phone_requests')) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.phone_requests', 'harold.phone_requests.wrong') AND (MetricName != 'harold.phone_requests' OR Attributes['channel'] != 'web_app') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR

SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e9) FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.phone_request' AND SpanAttributes['pane_id'] != '' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND Timestamp < now()

SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e9) FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.phone_request' AND SpanAttributes['pane_id'] != '' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND Timestamp < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT sum(rise) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.turns') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now())) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT sum(specs) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS specs FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.specs' AND Attributes['state'] = 'open' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() AND $__filters GROUP BY ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'], Attributes['pod.product'])

SELECT sum(specs) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS specs FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.specs' AND Attributes['state'] = 'open' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__filters GROUP BY ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'], Attributes['pod.product'])

SELECT quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(total_rise / count_rise, toUInt64(count_rise)) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, if(count < count_before, count, count - count_before) AS count_rise, if(count < count_before, total, total - total_before) AS total_rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, toFloat64(Count) AS count, Sum AS total, lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_before, lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_before FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() AND $__filters)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND count_rise > 0 AND Attributes['phase'] = 'open_to_approved'

tiles.name: Waiting for you, p50, previous 24 h

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(total_rise / count_rise, toUInt64(count_rise)) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, if(count < count_before, count, count - count_before) AS count_rise, if(count < count_before, total, total - total_before) AS total_rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, toFloat64(Count) AS count, Sum AS total, lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_before, lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_before FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__filters)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND count_rise > 0 AND Attributes['phase'] = 'open_to_approved'

SELECT quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(total_rise / count_rise, toUInt64(count_rise)) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, if(count < count_before, count, count - count_before) AS count_rise, if(count < count_before, total, total - total_before) AS total_rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, toFloat64(Count) AS count, Sum AS total, lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_before, lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_before FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() AND $__filters)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND count_rise > 0 AND Attributes['phase'] = 'started_to_completed'

SELECT quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(total_rise / count_rise, toUInt64(count_rise)) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, if(count < count_before, count, count - count_before) AS count_rise, if(count < count_before, total, total - total_before) AS total_rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes, toFloat64(Count) AS count, Sum AS total, lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS count_before, lagInFrame(Sum, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_before FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR AND TimeUnix < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__filters)) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND count_rise > 0 AND Attributes['phase'] = 'started_to_completed'

SELECT Attributes['agent'] AS agent, Attributes['channel'] AS channel, sumIf(rise, Attributes['outcome'] = 'sent') AS sent, sumIf(rise, Attributes['outcome'] = 'kept') AS kept FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.notifications') AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND TimeUnix < $__toTime AND $__filters)) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY agent, channel ORDER BY agent, channel

tiles.name: Spoken lines dropped while locked, by pane, per day

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, LogAttributes['pane_id'] AS pane_id, count() AS dropped FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'spoken line dropped (screen locked)' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, pane_id ORDER BY day DESC, dropped DESC

tiles.name: Call turn, time to first sound and to the answer, last 7 days

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT SpanAttributes['call_from'] AS call_from, SpanAttributes['answered_by'] AS answered_by, count() AS turns, quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat64(SpanAttributes['first_sound_ms']) / 1000, SpanAttributes['first_sound_ms'] != '') AS first_sound_p50_s, quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat64(SpanAttributes['first_sound_ms']) / 1000, SpanAttributes['first_sound_ms'] != '') AS first_sound_p95_s, quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat64(SpanAttributes['answer_ms']) / 1000, SpanAttributes['answer_ms'] != '') AS answer_p50_s, quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat64(SpanAttributes['answer_ms']) / 1000, SpanAttributes['answer_ms'] != '') AS answer_p95_s, countIf(TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.call_transcribe' AND toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['load_waited_ms']) > 0 AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now())) AS waited_for_the_load FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.call_turn' AND SpanAttributes['call_from'] != '' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY call_from, answered_by ORDER BY call_from, answered_by

SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS failed FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.call_answer' AND SpanAttributes['result'] = 'failed' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['cost_micros'])) / 1000000 AS spend_usd FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.call_answer' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, SpanAttributes['exception.type'] AS exception_type, SpanAttributes['code.filepath'] AS script, count() AS errors FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold-web-app' AND SpanName = 'browser.error' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, exception_type, script ORDER BY day DESC, errors DESC

SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS loads, quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1000000000 AS p50_s, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1000000000 AS p95_s FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold-web-app' AND SpanName = 'documentLoad' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

tiles.name: Browser spans not forwarded per day

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(TimeUnix) AS day, Attributes['reason'] AS reason, sum(rise) AS spans FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, Attributes, Value, lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.app_spans.not_forwarded') AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND TimeUnix < now())) WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY day, reason ORDER BY day DESC, reason

SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS phone_turns, countIf(ParentSpanId != '') AS joined, round(100 * joined / phone_turns, 1) AS joined_percent FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.turn' AND SpanAttributes['started_by'] = 'phone' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS spans FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold-web-app' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

tiles.name: Thread opened at the oldest row, 7 days

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() AS opens, countIf(SpanAttributes['harold.opened_at'] = 'oldest_on_page') AS at_oldest_row, round(100 * at_oldest_row / opens, 1) AS oldest_percent FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold-web-app' AND SpanName = 'browser.thread_opened' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now()

tiles.name: Web app posts refused, by route, per day

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, LogAttributes['route'] AS route, count() AS refused FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'app post refused' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day DESC, refused DESC

tiles.name: Pages closed without a hidden report, share per day

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS closes, round(100 * countIf(LogAttributes['hidden_reported'] = 'false') / count(), 1) AS without_report_percent, countIf(LogAttributes['hidden_reported'] = 'repeated') AS repeated FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'app page disconnected' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

tiles.name: Knowledge index: hours since the last good pass (info; the line is 2)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round((toUnixTimestamp(now()) - toUnixTimestamp(max(Timestamp))) / 3600, 1) FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'knowledge indexed' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

tiles.name: Notes searches by source: median ms, searches, searches with 0 results

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT SpanAttributes['source'] AS source, quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['embed_ms']) + toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['search_ms'])) AS median_ms, count() AS searches, countIf(SpanAttributes['results'] = '0') AS no_results FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.knowledge.search' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY source ORDER BY searches DESC

tiles.name: Knowledge worker, last 7 days: highest rss_mb, mean ms a passage, passages

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['rss_mb'])) AS highest_rss_mb, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['embed_ms_per_passage'])), 1) AS mean_ms_per_passage, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['passages'])) AS passages FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'knowledge worker stopped' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

tiles.name: buckwal commits that failed, per hour

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS hour, count() AS failed_commits FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'buckwal.commit' AND SpanAttributes['buckwal.outcome'] = 'error' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour DESC

tiles.name: Graph records waiting (info; the line is 0)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toStartOfDay(TimeUnix) AS day, max(Value) AS waiting FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'harold.knowledge.graph_waiting' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND TimeUnix < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

SELECT toStartOfDay(TimeUnix) AS day, max(Value) AS typed_relations FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'harold.knowledge.typed_relations' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND TimeUnix < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

tiles.name: TTS time to first audio, p50 and p95 by machine, loaded and device, last 7 days

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, SpanAttributes['loaded'] AS loaded, SpanAttributes['device'] AS device, count() AS lines, quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['first_audio_ms'])) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['first_audio_ms'])) AS p95_ms FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.tts.speak' AND SpanAttributes['result'] = 'spoke' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, machine, loaded, device ORDER BY day DESC, machine, loaded, device

tiles.name: TTS failures per day, by machine, caller and reason

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, LogAttributes['caller'] AS caller, LogAttributes['reason'] AS reason, count() AS failed FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'tts failed' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, machine, caller, reason ORDER BY day DESC, failed DESC

tiles.name: Agent inventory full reads per day, by reason

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, LogAttributes['reason'] AS reason, count() AS full_reads FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND Body = 'agent inventory full read' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < now() GROUP BY day, reason ORDER BY day DESC, full_reads DESC
